title_zh: 一签｜文字盲盒与像素签名
title_en: One Fortune | Notes to Draw and Keep
description_zh:
一签是一只随身文字盲盒。按下抽签，拆开一封未知的信：可能是一首古诗、一句冷幽默、一个荒诞脑洞，也可能是生活观察或一点安慰。喜欢哪一句，就连同像素风景收进16格签册，随时翻阅，也能选作自己的个人签名展示。

内置2,200张完整签文：1,980条原创短句与220条古诗词摘句，诗词显示作者和篇名。默认从全库随机抽取；想专门读某类内容，可在类型页选好并确认。同一轮不重复，回首页或重启恢复全库随机。安慰占签库20%、诗词占10%，其余带来更多关于日常、关系、审美与出走的不同说法。

随机抽签途中，还会偶遇30款“奇遇签”：鲸游星海、星环旅馆、深海珍珠等独立场景，配上专属原创短句、金色拆信、各自的登场动画与情境音效。鲸浮出海面，末班车驶入月台，水洼先映出彩虹，随后回到安静的微动效。每款有三种珍藏配色，发现即永久留下，不占普通签册；随时找回原版或设为个人签名，集齐之前优先遇见新款。

也可以选择“连续来信”，随机看看一组故事的开头，喜欢就选定、顺着读下去。《风停邮局》《月台失物》《海边修灯人》《屋顶花园》四组原创来信，用短句、像素配图和留白连接起完整故事。每组分别记住读到哪里，随时停下，再回来接着读。

封好的信轻轻晃动、拆开、揭晓，短小的音乐盒音效陪着这份期待；音量可调，也能静音。十个像素系列提供320款皮肤、1,920种外观，随机换风景，文字保持原样。收藏卡片可重新展示、换肤或移出，满额时由你确认替换。再抽保留签册和已留签名；读连续信时重启则继续上次的那一页。完全离线，无需配网或付费。签文用于阅读、表达和娱乐，不作未来预测。

封面为玩法示意；三张详情图为实际程序主机渲染与说明，非设备实拍。
description_en:
One Fortune is a pocket surprise box of words. Press to draw and open an unknown letter: a classical verse, a dry joke, a surreal idea, an everyday observation or a little reassurance. Keep a line and its pixel-art scenery in a 16-card album. Browse your favorites whenever you like, or choose one as your personal signature.

Discover 2,200 complete notes: 1,980 original lines and 220 classical Chinese poetry excerpts with author and work title. Draw randomly across the whole collection by default, or confirm one of eight themes on the type selector. Notes do not repeat within a cycle. Returning home or restarting restores whole-bank draws. Reassurance makes up 20% of the collection and poetry 10%; the rest brings different perspectives on daily life, relationships, taste and small outings.

A random draw can also bring one of 30 rare encounters: a whale among stars, a ringed-planet hotel, a deep-sea pearl and other individually illustrated scenes, each with an original line, a golden envelope, its own arrival animation and a scene-matched score. A whale rises from the sea, the last train enters a platform, and a puddle reflects a rainbow before settling into quiet ambient motion. Each has three collectible palettes. Discoveries are kept permanently outside the ordinary album; retrieve an original or display it as your signature. Undiscovered cards take priority until your collection is complete.

Choose Continuous Letters to preview a random story opening, then select one you like and keep reading. Four original sequences—Windstill Post Office, Platform Lost Property, The Lighthouse Keeper and Rooftop Garden—unfold through short lines, pixel illustrations and pauses. Each story remembers its own reading position, so you can stop and return whenever you like.

A sealed letter shakes, opens and reveals its words, accompanied by brief music-box sounds. Adjust the volume or mute them. Ten pixel-art collections offer 320 skins and 1,920 appearances to discover in shuffled order. Change the scenery while keeping the words. Display a favorite, change its artwork or remove it; replacing a card in a full album requires your confirmation. Drawing again keeps your album and signature. Restarting during a continuous story restores its reading page. Fully offline, with no Wi-Fi setup or payment. The interface and notes are Chinese, intended for reading, expression and entertainment rather than predictions.

The cover is a gameplay illustration. Three detail images use actual application host renders and explanatory graphics, not device photographs.
instructions_zh:
1. 开机即用，无需配网；黑屏按任意键唤醒，长按确定回首页。
2. 首页确定抽签，揭晓时确定可跳过；结果页上再抽、下换肤、确定收藏并展示为签名。
3. 首页上/下打开类型页，选好后确定。“连续来信”预览时上换故事、下换肤、确定选定；阅读时确定下一页、上回看，长确定退出，再选同组续读。
4. 首页长确定或签名页短确定打开签册，上/下翻阅、确定整理；隐藏款自动珍藏，可从类型页“奇遇珍藏”查看。
5. 卡片页长上调音量，上/下调节、确定保存；长下开关声音。签名、收藏和进度重启保留。
instructions_en:
1. Turn on the device; no Wi-Fi setup is needed. Press any button to wake a dark screen. Hold OK to return home.
2. On home, press OK to draw; press OK during the reveal to skip. On the result, UP draws again, DOWN changes artwork, and OK collects and displays your signature.
3. On home, UP/DOWN opens the type selector; choose a type and confirm with OK. In Continuous Letters, UP previews another story, DOWN changes artwork, and OK selects it. While reading, OK advances and UP goes back. Hold OK to leave; select the same story to resume.
4. Hold OK on home, or press OK briefly on the signature, to open the album. Browse with UP/DOWN and press OK for actions. Rare cards are collected automatically; find them under Rare Collection in the type selector.
5. On a card, hold UP for volume, adjust with UP/DOWN and save with OK. Hold DOWN to toggle sound. Signatures, collections and reading progress survive restarts.
changelog_zh:
• 现有30款奇遇签加入各自的登场动画：鲸浮出海面、末班车驶入月台、水洼映出彩虹，随后回到安静的微动效。
• 揭晓配上海潮、列车、雨滴、花园、星光、发条六种情境音效，跟随音量与静音设置；按确定可跳过。
• 抽取概率、保底和收藏规则保持不变，沿用已有签名、收藏、来信进度和奇遇珍藏。
changelog_en:
• Gives each of the existing 30 rare encounters its own arrival: a whale rises from the sea, the last train enters a platform, and a puddle reflects a rainbow before returning to quiet ambient motion.
• Adds six scene-matched scores—tide, railway, rain, garden, starlight and clockwork—following your volume and mute settings. Press OK to skip the reveal.
• Draw chances, guarantees and collection rules stay unchanged. Existing signatures, favorites, story bookmarks and rare discoveries are retained.
